testimonials.name: Austin Rideshare Analyst
testimonials.text: Austin's premium rideshare segment has grown 40% year-over-year. The market consistently lacks enough premium-tier vehicles to meet demand — especially during events like SXSW, ACL, and F1. A well-branded luxury vehicle fleet is exactly what this market needs.

founder.name: Dylan Disney
founder.title: Founder & Managing Member
founder.bio: Dylan Disney is the Founder and Managing Member of Ezra Mobility Group LLC. A proud U.S. Navy Veteran, Dylan served as a Personnel Specialist aboard the USS Gunston Hall and USS Pearl Harbor, where he developed a strong foundation in administrative excellence, discipline, and operational leadership. Bringing over a decade of direct experience in the rideshare and transportation industry, he possesses an intricate understanding of driver logistics, client expectations, and market dynamics. Currently advancing his expertise through a Business Administration degree at Austin Community College, Dylan is dedicated to leveraging his extensive background to elevate the standard of professional mobility and fleet management in the Austin, Texas market.

about.mission: To build Austin's premium luxury vehicle fleet, deploy it across the highest-earning rideshare tiers, and create a scalable model for premium fleet ownership that benefits investors, drivers, and the community.
about.story: Ezra Mobility Group LLC was founded in Austin, Texas — one of the fastest-growing cities in the US and a top-tier rideshare market. We saw a gap: there aren't enough premium-tier vehicles to meet demand, especially during major events. Our solution: a planned fleet of black-on-black luxury vehicles spanning premium and Comfort tiers. We're in our launch phase and actively seeking investment partners and vehicle owner-operators to bring this vision to the road.

values.title: Market Fit First
values.description: Austin's premium rideshare demand far exceeds supply. Our fleet targets the highest-revenue tiers, plus budget-friendly Comfort options.

values.title: Premium Quality
values.description: Every vehicle in our fleet is held to a premium black-on-black standard — from luxury SUVs to Comfort-tier sedans.

values.title: Scalable Partnership Model
values.description: We structure investments and partnerships so everyone wins: investors, owner-operators, and drivers. No one carries the full burden alone.
